$comment: Requirements whose status differed between the status matrices of 17 and 18 October 2026, with the proposed status for the current source, the reason and the measure. Proposed by the author of the matrix for confirmation by the QA sign-off (Atoosa Eslami); a deviation from a MUST requirement (status GAP or a PARTIAL that will not be closed before the resubmission) needs the prior written agreement of the principal. The evidence field is filled from the runs on the release candidate tag.

statuses.EVIDENCE_LINKED: executed result for the current source linked
statuses.PARTIAL: source exists; acceptance or external evidence outstanding

items.reason: PCI's own transient-data handling is implemented and tested; R4-3 adds the collection of the captures for the canary scan. The whole-chain check depends on the deployment of the upstream payload-logging fixes by the OCM owner.
items.measure: Canary scan with scripts/collect-privacy-captures.py and scripts/privacy-audit.py on both QA deployments after a successful and a failed synthetic issuance (R5); written notice of the upstream dependency to the principal.

items.reason: A PCI/ directory for rc.12 has been in eclipse-xfsc/deployment since 17 October 2026, uploaded directly to main and not through a pull request; the acceptance criterion requires pull requests merged by a maintainer. R4-4 generates the package from the source.
items.measure: Pull request to eclipse-xfsc/deployment replacing PCI/ with the export of the release candidate, reviewed and merged by its maintainers.

items.reason: The documentation built strictly but was published only on manual dispatch. R3-8 publishes it on every push to main and every release candidate tag and adds the troubleshooting and FAQ page; publication for the current source is not yet recorded.
items.measure: Documentation workflow run with publication on the release candidate tag, recorded in the evidence package.

items.reason: The baseline forced the FACIS palette, font and corners. R2-10 lets each tenant choose colors (with the contrast rules), one of five font stacks, the corner style and the page width, applied as soon as the branding is activated; the provider pages keep the FACIS standard. The live ad-hoc demonstration on a deployment is outstanding.
items.measure: Live demonstration of an ad-hoc theme change on the QA deployment during the internal milestone demonstration (R5), recorded with the test report.
